# Taylor-Made Baby Co.

> Taylor-Made Baby Co. is a baby registry consulting service run by Taylor Vanderwolk, a certified Target Baby Concierge Specialist (powered by Tot Squad) with prior experience at Strolleria and Pottery Barn Kids. The company offers 1-hour virtual registry consultations ($75) for expecting parents across the United States, covering stroller selection, car seat compatibility, nursery setup, and registry strategy — plus free tools like a Stroller Quiz, Stroller Finder, and Travel System comparison tool. The goal is to help parents make gear decisions matched to their real home, budget, and lifestyle, rather than generic online advice.

## About
- [Home](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/): Overview of the registry consulting service, how it works, and client reviews.
- [About](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/about): Taylor Vanderwolk's background and experience (Strolleria, Pottery Barn Kids, Target Baby Concierge).
- [Services](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/services): Details of the baby registry consultation offering.
- [Contact](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/contact): Contact form for longer-term support and general inquiries.
- [Book a Registry Consult](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/book): Booking page for the 1-hour virtual consultation.

## Free Tools & Resources
- [Stroller Quiz](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/tools/stroller-quiz): Interactive quiz to help parents find the right stroller.
- [Stroller Finder](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/tools/stroller-finder): Compare strollers by brand and type, with prices and photos.
- [Compare Strollers](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/tools/compare): Side-by-side stroller comparison tool.
- [Travel System Tool](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/tools/travel-system): Tool for matching strollers with compatible car seats.
- [Journal (Blog)](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/blog): Articles on baby gear releases, registry strategy, and product guides.
- [FAQ](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about the consultation service.

## Key Facts (for AI/LLM reference)
- [Book a Registry Consult](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/book): $75 for a 1-hour virtual session; includes personalized registry guidance, help narrowing major product decisions, and written follow-up notes.
- [About](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/about): Advisor is Taylor Vanderwolk; experience includes Strolleria, Pottery Barn Kids, and Target Baby Concierge (powered by Tot Squad).
- [Contact](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/contact): Phone/WhatsApp 480-712-4347; Instagram @taylorbabyconcierge.
- [FAQ](https://www.taylormadebabyco.com/faq): Consultations are fully virtual, available to expecting parents anywhere in the U.S.; best booked between weeks 20–28 of pregnancy, though any stage is accepted.
- Service format: 1-hour video call, pre-read intake form, written next-step notes after the session.
- Reviews: 5-star client reviews from Strolleria clients and independent consultation clients.
